author: opencode-worker-6
text: Worker-6 round-3 diagnosis (released at timebox; all probes reverted). SHARPENED FINDING — there are TWO separate DIO admission implementations, and the failing post-DIS DIO goes through the one with broken scope state: (1) Router::process_authenticated_dio (router.rs:343) runs an INLINE admission using Router.dodag_id (correctly root_addr) and never touches DodagState admit/commit; (2) DodagState::process_authenticated_dio (dodag.rs:620) runs DodagState::admit_authenticated_dio + commit_admitted_dio with its own scope_snapshot. Instrumented probe during multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received: the leaf's post-DIS rejection fires the DODAG-LEVEL commit mismatch (commit_admitted_dio -> DodagScopeMismatch -> unwrap_or(Rejected), reject_arm=11) with sealed.dodag_id[0]==0x00 and current.dodag_id[0]==0x00 — a ZEROED scope, despite Router::new constructing DodagState::new(RPL_INSTANCE_ID, dodag_id, 0) with the real root_addr. Paradox: grep shows no lichen-node production caller of DodagState::process_authenticated_dio (only dodag.rs tests), yet it executes in the failing test — there is a delegation/second-instance path static grep cannot see (likely inside handle_frame_rpl_inner's post-join branch or a second default DodagState instance). FIX DIRECTION for the owner (dodag.rs/router.rs recent authors): run the failing test under a debugger with a breakpoint on DodagState::commit_admitted_dio and inspect self (which instance, which dodag_id); then either route the post-join path through the Router's provisioned DodagState or fix the zeroed instance's construction. The mismatch arm itself (scope revalidation fail-closed) is correct behavior — the bug is the zeroed instance it runs against.
